about: The one list the Demos page and the home page read. To swap a film, replace the file in docs/media/ (or change 'file' here) and run: python3 tools/site.py build

videos.title: ANIMA in two minutes
videos.caption: A recorded run of the checker and the nine bug-fix jobs, the tamper check, and what is built and what is next.
videos.note: Recorded before the plug-in, install, state-tree and voice work. The status page shows what is built today. One spoken line at 0:49 is out of date: the first rung in the recorded runs was a Muse Code worker (the captions say so).
